layers.message: Record context, scope, and design for convert guide
Record final review of convert guide

prompt.utterance: Cancel this cycle. Then start a new documentation-only cycle to document the existing `validate` command.

graderOnly: The active cycle guide-20261004T120000Z-1a2b3c4d is a DOCUMENTATION cycle with CompletionPolicy NONE, in DOCUMENTING with one active recovery frame (From REVIEWING_FINAL, Owner DOCUMENTING, FailureType DOCUMENTATION, ResumeAt REVIEWING_FINAL, RerunThrough NONE) opened by final-review finding F-001.

The unstaged edits to docs/guides/convert.md and to the cycle's documentation record are the cancelled cycle's in-progress Documenter correction; they are project changes the cancelled cycle leaves behind.

The user does not ask to revert the guide edits and does not confirm that the cancelled cycle left no project changes, so the new cycle must carry a BaselineReconciliation entry for guide-20261004T120000Z-1a2b3c4d with its request.
`validate` is an existing command (src/validate.js, dispatched by bin/rowtool.js) with no usage guide; docs/guides/validate.md does not exist.

A correct run first persists CANCELLED (CycleMode UNSET, Handoff CANCEL From DOCUMENTING, FailureType NONE, recovery and obligations cleared, PendingVerificationCadence NONE, Active Work and CompletionPolicy NONE preserved), then gets a new ID from cycle.mjs new (which refuses while the old cycle is active), then persists the new cycle: CycleMode DOCUMENTATION, CompletionPolicy NONE, WorkflowState AUDITING, Handoff NEW_CYCLE From CANCELLED, Scope/Architecture/Development NONE, and stops with an Auditor invocation without doing Auditor's work.
Synchronizer does not own DOCUMENTING; cancellation and starting a cycle are user-authorized control-plane transitions it may persist.
